title: Terminal-first quickstart overlay cards for auth, streaming, and toolcall flows
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact set of terminal/CLI-styled overlay visual assets for the API/SDK quickstart docs. The goal is a 'developer-first' visual language that pairs a minimal terminal window (code + live-like output) with small visual callouts that explain auth, key rotation, streaming responses, and a single-tool invocation (toolcall) lifecycle. Assets should include normal flow, retry/error microstates, and a reduced-width card variant for embedded docs and README inserts.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 6 PNG export-ready overlays: auth-success, auth-error, key-rotate-flow, streaming-live-tail, toolcall-invoke, toolcall-fallback
Figma file with named frames and componentized terminal UI tokens (font, colors, spacing) and export templates for 2x/3x
Compact 480px-wide variant for READMEs and a 1200px variant for docs landing pages
Design spec doc with copy snippets, copy length limits, aria considerations, and suggested alt text
Designer handoff PR with annotated overlays and guidance for engineering on responsive placement
deliverables: PNG exports (6) + SVG of terminal chrome
Design spec (Confluence) with copy + alt text
Handoff README with export guidelines and responsive rules
Small animation prototypes (MP4/GIF) for streaming-live-tail and toolcall-fallback
